answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Every claim climbs the knoll of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the quartz re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, converted to a slow vesting stream. The marble of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
